description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Desch
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Violet Flash (0~2), removed after using Apex Violet Flash two times

description.name: Apex Violet Flash Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Violet Flash level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Lightning abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Desch]

description.name: Apex Violet Flash Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Violet Flash level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Desch]
